name: The Royal Game of Ur
author: Gelatin Studios
description: The Royal Game of Ur, one of the oldest known board games, for two players on one device. Up/Down to pick a piece, X to roll and move.

descriptions.en: The Royal Game of Ur, one of the oldest known board games, for two players on one device. Up/Down to pick a piece, X to roll and move.
descriptions.it: Il Gioco reale di Ur, uno dei giochi da tavolo più antichi, per due giocatori sullo stesso dispositivo. Su/giù per scegliere la pedina, X per tirare e muovere.
